name: kiln-ds-system
description: kiln-ds design system: tokens, React components and the docs book. Built with the kiln engine.

scripts.docs:build: pnpm --filter kiln-ds-react build && pnpm --filter kiln-ds-docs build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter kiln-ds-react typecheck && pnpm --filter kiln-ds-docs exec tsc --noEmit -p .
scripts.gate:selftest: node tooling/hooks.selftest.mjs && node tooling/no-hardcode-lint.selftest.mjs && node tooling/contrast-check.selftest.mjs && node tooling/generate-barrel.selftest.mjs && node tooling/pack-verify.selftest.mjs && node tooling/kiln/rationale.selftest.mjs
